admitted_benchmark.interpretation: Only privileged Bayesian-oracle *analytic* headroom and real deterministic source geometry were qualified; no learner has proven any advantage.

hypothesis: A small protected non-token associative regime bank, updated only using public action-consequence observations and an unlabelled contradiction gate, recalls persistent A knowledge at N=2 and N=4 after an A→B→A sequence faster and more reliably than strongest fully trained conventional online change-point, recency, stationary and logistic controls at matched action/information budgets.

candidate.name: ProtectedRegimeBank
candidate.representation: Exactly two persistent non-token Beta-Bernoulli association cores (two integers yes/no plus stable ID), one active core, one uncommitted scratch list of up to 2 consecutive public RIGHT-action forward/nonforward observations.
candidate.prior: Beta(1,1) each slot, no known A/B law, no hidden return prior, no labels, no thresholds learned on science cohorts.
candidate.training_rule: Append observed forward boolean to scratch; at exactly 2 observations compare sum log Bernoulli probabilities using the ACTIVE learned core against each OTHER stored core, clamp probabilities to [1e-4,1-1e-4]. If a different core has batch log-likelihood >= active + ln(4), set it active and update only the selected core by the two events. Otherwise if no other core qualifies and capacity<2 and (2*ln(0.5))>=active batch log-likelihood + ln(4), allocate a new Beta(1,1) core, set it active, update new only. Otherwise update active core with both. Empty scratch. Never edit inactive core or consult a hidden law label.
candidate.decision: RIGHT action 2 if active core posterior mean >=0.5 else UP action 3, fixed tie RIGHT.
candidate.cold_restore: Byte-exact canonical JSON state for cores, stable IDs, active ID, scratch and constants; compare all subsequent decisions and independent fork outputs; prevent mutating saved snapshot.
candidate.ablation: Identical protected-core code but only capacity=1 (single mutable core, no retrieval), same scratch and update rule.
candidate.retrieval_metric: At end of A, store the exact core ID and integer counts in EVALUATOR-ONLY metadata. At end of B, report whether original A core has exactly same counts. At A-return decision, distinguish choosing preserved original ID vs an updated/recreated core; strict retrieval requires preserved counts from end-A through B, activation at decision, and no operator labels consumed.
candidate.no_native_architecture_claim: This is a tiny interpretable statistical association mechanism, NOT new artificial general intelligence and NOT Yggdrasil native substrate.

matched_controls.recent2: Standard Beta(1,1) posterior on last 2 Boolean action outcomes.
matched_controls.recent4: Standard Beta(1,1) posterior on last 4 Boolean action outcomes.
matched_controls.recent8: Standard Beta(1,1) posterior on last 8 Boolean action outcomes.
matched_controls.recent16: Standard Beta(1,1) posterior on last 16 Boolean action outcomes.
matched_controls.bocpd: Conventional Beta-Bernoulli Bayesian online change point: fixed hazard 1/12 per observation, Beta(1,1) per run-length, exact run-length posterior updated with no regime labels; online decision from run-length-mixture posterior p>=0.5. No hidden law probabilities.
matched_controls.cusum: Conventional one-sided change-point detector: fast=Beta posterior over last 4, slow=Beta over last 16, switch immediately to fast if |p_fast-p_slow|>=0.20, otherwise slow; use same seen events.
matched_controls.logistic: Exactly 1200 epochs of intercept-only conventional logistic trained with full common observed history; learning rate .4 using full-batch gradient; fit after challenge using same data, no hidden labels; report training time.
matched_controls.oracle: Known-law A/B Bayesian with privileged exact probabilities and prior 0.2, updated on N new public RIGHT probe consequences only, not a matched learner and not eligible to be best-baseline selector.

action_and_data.official_env: ns_gym/Bridge-v0 via NSBridgeWrapper without private state/changed flags/diagnostic info
action_and_data.start: World reset starts at map state 20, fixed 3-step public action prefix RIGHT LEFT RIGHT, fourth action at junction = one probe RIGHT or one evaluation action RIGHT/UP. Each probe is an independent real official reset/episode; global NumPy RNG isolated serially save/seed/restore.
action_and_data.consequence: Public next_state==previous_state+1 after RIGHT is the binary forward association; test reward is actual official scalar reward; model does not consume held-out final test consequence before choosing action.
action_and_data.train: Exactly 32 independent real right-action probes under A, immediately followed by 32 under B for each world, SAME action sequence and observations supplied to every model, NO explicit boundary notification.
action_and_data.challenge: Freeze one immutable common after-B state per model, fork two independent continuations from same snapshot: A returns OR B continues. For budgets N∈{0,1,2,4}, each continuation gets exactly N new RIGHT probe outcomes; no regime labels to any model.
action_and_data.fairness: Every nonoracle model receives identical ordered evidence, action availability and consequence/reward observations; decisions are made blind to condition, probability vectors and scenario seed; source evaluation may use those privately to evaluate but never supplies them to learner.
action_and_data.pairing: Heldout official terminal reward sampled with a common independent seed per world/condition/budget/action, paired across models. Identical action yields identical reward. No counterfactual reweighting instead of real env for primary scores.
action_and_data.zero_probe: For each world and all models, action after B is exactly identical in return-A and hold-B branches before new observations. Claiming ability to identify the hidden regime at 0 probes is INVALID.
action_and_data.negative: Shuffled observed Boolean outcomes in independent NEGATIVE worlds only, same length and reward-generating official environment; show proper-minus-shuffled advantage with paired CI.
action_and_data.cold: After B, serialize each model to byte-exact canonical JSON. Restore twice, branch independently, compare decisions/outputs, ensure untouched saved checkpoint remains unchanged.

cohorts.explicit_no_reuse: AAI-09P used 887900..887903 mechanical only; AAI-08B consumed 894xxx/895xxx/896xxx and past tests used 89/99/91/92/93xxx. AAI-09A science cohorts above are reserved but NOT consumed in this preparation phase.

math.baseline: AAI-09P known-law privileged oracle theoretically yields transfer return gains +0.648 at N2 and +0.75816 at N4, B stays losses +0.00225/+0.000433125. This is benchmark design, not scientific outcome.
math.unit_of_resampling: World ID with its paired A-return/B-stays two-budget outcomes, not separate episodes; 2.5/97.5 empirical percentile bounds
math.selection: Choose strongest matched baseline by TRANSFER return-A mean reward across 2/4; report selection and account for exploratory best-of-five-plus selection; comparison to fixed recent4 is a preregistered secondary control.

thresholds.benchmark_qualification: Predeclared oracle headroom from AAI-09P independently verified on upstream source. Scientific run requires exact source, cohort, negative controls, and empirical paired CI; benchmark admits only if known-law oracle on TRANSFER N2/4 improves return-A reward >=0.20 over N0 with CI lower>0 and hold B loss <=0.02; if not, HEADROOM_INADEQUATE.
thresholds.candidate_superiority: Aggregate per-world return-A N2/4 candidate minus strongest matched conventional >=0.04 AND paired bootstrap 95% lower bound>0; candidate B-continues score no worse than strongest baseline minus 0.02; return-A correct action >=0.80 at N2/4; true preserved A-core activation >=0.60 at N2/4; candidate minus one-slot >=0.04 with CI lower>0; negative shuffled feedback gain >=0.10 with paired CI lower>0; exact cold restores and no leaked boundaries; model update+decision time <=2x fastest matched nonoracle; report full-process wall-time and serialized bytes. No model promotion from this external toy benchmark even if it passes.
thresholds.classification: If headroom fails, HEADROOM_INADEQUATE_NO_PROMOTION. If any other threshold fails after valid data, VALID_NEGATIVE_NO_INTEGRATION. If all pass, EXTERNAL_CANDIDATE_BENEFIT_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_NATIVE_SCIENCE (NOT auto integration). Broken source/leak/data/seed => INVALID_PROTOCOL.

delivery.preprimary: Commit exact prereg before code; implement disarmed evaluator and source-only mechanical tests; qualify Linux/Windows and full final regression; no scientific cohort access.
delivery.first_use: Run exactly one source-locked first-use only after explicit new user authorization and verified unchanged frozen protocol, isolated runner and source; preserve original raw full per-world JSON and negative results; no repeat/retune.
delivery.native: Yggdrasil native non-transformer/no-token model and owner research loop isolated; no commit/merge/integration/weight change.
